explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with OAI classifications 797 and 1530 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the remifentanil hydrochloride shortage on 2022-06-28 and it has remained current for 52 months as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage lists Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., and Mylan Institutional as affected manufacturers.
Our inventory at both Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside carries NDC 00143939210 labeled by Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.
That NDC maps to label set 9d289052 which names Hospira, Inc. and Navinta LLC as registered manufacturing plants.
FDA's OAI classification letter to Hospira, Inc. is dated 2020-04-22, 797 days before the shortage posting.
FDA's OAI classification letter to Navinta LLC is dated 2018-04-20, 1530 days before the shortage posting.
The rule-based transfer option moves 16 units from Corvale General (17 days on hand) to Corvale Lakeside (6.8 days on hand) so both sites reach at least two weeks of supply.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-7687c6.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%remifentanil%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%remifentanil%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-c52a25.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('9d289052-1eb6-4ba2-a3ca-d2e542a052ae') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-c79f59.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%remifentanil%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-d13192.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%remifentanil%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-a717bb.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%remifentanil%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-87f84d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1925262', '3004375014', '3001833549') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-fa15d4.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1925262', '3004375014') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hospira', 'navinta')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-f37da6.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hospira', 'navinta', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%remifentanil%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-8e0f55.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('976095', '1064827', '971010') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr
